orchestrator.description: Prioritizes findings, reviews fixes, verifies results

worker.description: Audits the target and implements fixes

steps.label: Audit
steps.description: Analyze the target according to the brief's criteria. Write prioritized findings to context/audit-findings.md. Update context/status.md.

steps.label: Fix
steps.description: Read context/audit-findings.md. Address findings, highest priority first. Commit each fix. Update context/status.md with what was fixed.

steps.label: Verify
steps.description: Re-audit to confirm fixes resolved the issues. Read context/audit-findings.md and compare. Write context/verification-report.md. Update context/status.md.
